briefdescription.para: Return the plugin internal representation of a module execution config.

detaileddescription.para: This is a tuple with a module name (mandatory), a method name for the execution to start with (defaults to "run"), and a list of arguments to pass to the launcher that performs the execution. The arguments, as per Gradle convention, should be possible to be configured lazily as a provider, so they can be calculated at the time of execution, and not at the time of configuration.
TODO: This is not supported everywhere yet, but please feel free to add DSL logic for that, where you find it missing, and unit tests to make sure it works.

briefdescription.para: Whether to run multiple modules in parallel.

detaileddescription.para: When true and multiple modules are configured, they will be executed concurrently in separate processes. Defaults to false (sequential execution).
